reconstructionNotice: Rear three-quarter view at a door: the black zip blouson front and the cream crewneck sweatshirt front are conservative reconstructions from the visible collar, hem and zip edge. The keys in the lock are a scene prop. The black rectangular watch face is only partly visible. White socks show above the black penny loafers under charcoal cropped trousers. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

copy.titleEn: A GLANCE BACK AT THE DOOR

title.en: A glance back at the door
title.de: Ein Blick zurück an der Tür

deck.ko: 검정 블루종 아래 크림 밑단과 흰 발목의 선명한 간격.
deck.en: Cream at the hem and white at the ankles interrupt black and charcoal.
deck.de: Creme am Saum und Weiß am Knöchel unterbrechen Schwarz und Anthrazit.

intro.ko: 문을 열면서 뒤를 보는 각도에 짧은 재킷의 뒷선이 드러납니다.
intro.en: The backward glance while opening the door reveals the short jacket from behind.
intro.de: Beim Türöffnen zeigt der Blick zurück die kurze Jacke von hinten.

body.ko: 검정 블루종의 모인 밑단 아래로 크림 크루넥이 조금 이어집니다. 차콜 크롭 트라우저는 검정과 가까운 색을 유지하면서 흰 양말과 페니 로퍼 사이에 또렷한 끝점을 만듭니다. 가는 검정 스트랩의 직사각 시계는 문고리를 잡는 손목에서 보입니다. 낮의 플래시는 뒤돌아선 재킷 주름과 바지의 여유를 동시에 드러냅니다.
body.en: A little cream crewneck hem extends below the gathered black blouson. Charcoal cropped trousers keep the palette close while defining the white socks above penny loafers. A rectangular watch on a narrow black strap appears at the reaching wrist. Daytime flash shows rear jacket folds and the relaxed trouser line together.
body.de: Ein kleiner cremefarbener Saum liegt unter dem gerafften schwarzen Blouson. Die verkürzte anthrazitfarbene Hose bleibt im dunklen Farbbereich und grenzt weiße Socken über Pennyloafern klar ab. Am ausgestreckten Handgelenk erscheint eine rechteckige Uhr mit schmalem schwarzem Band. Tagesblitz zeigt Jackenfalten von hinten und die lockere Hosenlinie zugleich.

pull.ko: 어두운 옷 사이에 남긴 밝은 두 줄.
pull.en: Two light intervals within the dark layers.
pull.de: Zwei helle Abstände zwischen dunklen Lagen.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Two light intervals within the dark layers.

tip.ko: 크림 밑단을 고르게 펴고 양말 커프를 접지 않아 밝은 간격을 일정하게 유지하세요.
tip.en: Keep the cream hem even and the sock cuffs unfolded for consistent light intervals.
tip.de: Den cremefarbenen Saum gleichmäßig und die Sockenbündchen ungefaltelt halten.

description.ko: 작은 칼라와 긴소매, 모인 커프와 밑단, 측면 포켓의 짧은 재킷입니다.
description.en: Short black jacket with small collar, long sleeves, gathered cuffs and hem, and side pockets.
description.de: Kurze schwarze Jacke mit kleinem Kragen, langen Ärmeln, gerafften Bündchen und Seitentaschen.

howToWear.ko: 크림 이너 밑단이 조금 남도록 블루종 밑단을 자연스럽게 두세요.
howToWear.en: Let a little cream hem extend beneath the blouson's gathered edge.
howToWear.de: Einen kleinen cremefarbenen Saum unter dem gerafften Blousonrand zeigen.
